entries.english: Eat this to fill your belly!

review.previous: Eat this to fill your belly!

source.japanese:
{tab:09}装備すると攻撃力が上がるぞ！
Bボタンでメニューを開き
「道具」コマンドで装備しよう！

entries.english:
Equip this to raise your attack!
Press B to open the menu, then
choose Items to equip it.

review.previous:
Equip this to raise your attack!
Press B to open the menu, then
choose Items to equip it.

source.japanese:
{tab:09}これをふれば はなれている
モンスターにも攻撃できるぞ！
{tab:09}Rボタンをちょっと押してから十字ボタンで
モンスターのほうを向いてから使おう！

entries.english:
Wave this staff to attack
monsters from a distance!
	Tap R, then use the Control Pad
to face a monster before using it!

review.previous:
Wave this staff to attack
monsters from a distance!
	Tap R, then use the Control Pad
to face a monster before using it!
review.reason: Preserves distance attack and the sequence of tapping R, then turning with the Control Pad, then using the staff.

source.japanese:
{tab:09}読むと 部屋にいるモンスターに
大きなダメージをあたえられるぞ！

entries.english:
Read this to deal heavy damage
to the monsters in the room!

review.previous:
Read this to deal heavy damage
to the monsters in the room!
review.reason: Preserves heavy damage to monsters in the current room, not adjacent monsters or every floor.

source.japanese:
{tab:09}これをのむとHPが回復するぞ！
ピンチになったら のもう！

entries.english:
Drink this to recover HP!
Use it when you're in trouble!

review.previous:
Drink this to recover HP!
Use it when you're in trouble!
review.reason: Preserves HP recovery and advice to drink when in trouble.

source.japanese:
{tab:09}これをのむと となりに火を
はいて攻撃することができるぞ！
{tab:09}Rボタンをちょっと押してから十字ボタンで
モンスターのほうを向いてからのもう！

entries.english:
Drink this to breathe fire at
a monster next to you!
	Tap R, then use the Control Pad
to face a monster before drinking!

review.previous:
Drink this to breathe fire at
a monster next to you!
	Tap R, then use the Control Pad
to face a monster before drinking!
review.reason: Preserves drinking to breathe fire at an adjacent target, and tapping R then turning before drinking.

review.previous: Drink this to gain a level!
review.reason: Preserves gaining a level by drinking.
